The Eeshavana idea

A little closer to what matters.

Some places are not about doing more. They are about having the space to slow down, spend time outdoors and bring people together.

Eeshavana is envisioned as a small farm community shaped around the landscape and the presence of the Kaveri. The plan brings together private plots, shared spaces and a nature-led setting.

It is a place to imagine a future farm home, weekend retreat or a gathering place for family—while being part of a considered community.

Good to know

Questions, answered simply.

What is Eeshavana?

Eeshavana is a proposed premium Kaveri riverfront farm community by Vanatvam near Kollegala, Karnataka.

How large is the project?

The current project brief describes a 6.5-acre community. Please ask the project team for the latest survey and area documents.

What plot sizes are available?

The brochure states that plots start from 8,000 sq. ft. and above; another brochure describes approximately 8,700 sq. ft. Final plot sizes and availability should be confirmed with the current inventory and approved plan.

Are the amenities already built?

No. The bio-pool, amphitheatre, temple, landscaped garden, play area, riverside promenade, dining deck and sitting decks shown here are proposed concepts, not representations of completed facilities.

Can I review the plan and documents before deciding?

Yes. Request the latest master plan, title and land records, applicable approvals, permitted-use details, plot schedule, proposed development scope and maintenance terms. Have the documents independently reviewed before making a decision.

Can I build a home on a plot?

Permitted use and construction rights depend on the land classification, applicable planning rules and required permissions. Please obtain written confirmation from the project team and independent legal advice before assuming a farmhouse or residence can be built.

Is this an investment with guaranteed returns?

No return or appreciation is promised on this page. Land ownership carries legal, market, liquidity and development risks. Evaluate the documents and your own circumstances before proceeding.

How can I arrange a site visit?

Use the enquiry form below or contact Vanatvam directly to request the latest project information and arrange a visit.
